SELECT next_record.category_id FROM time_record prev_record JOIN sys_work_calendar calendar ON calendar.calendar_date = prev_record.date JOIN time_record next_record ON prev_record.user_id = next_record.user_id AND prev_record.date = next_record.date WHERE prev_record.user_id = #{userId} AND prev_record.category_id = #{previousCategoryId} AND next_record.start_time = prev_record.end_time + 1 AND next_record.category_id != #{previousCategoryId} AND prev_record.is_deleted = 0 AND next_record.is_deleted = 0
AND calendar.day_type IN (0, 3)
AND calendar.day_type IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY next_record.category_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT category_id FROM time_record JOIN sys_work_calendar calendar ON calendar.calendar_date = time_record.date WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time <= #{time} AND end_time >= #{time} AND is_deleted = 0
AND category_id != #{excludeCategoryId}
AND calendar.day_type IN (0, 3)
AND calendar.day_type IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
